entries.24157b1e7cea0818: This business centers on sales of prepaid eSIMs for inbound visitors to Japan. Taking advantage of the fact that they can be used immediately once downloaded to a smartphone, it also runs cross-selling of digital products to existing customers and an EC business for new customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥75 million.
entries.301ed7cc11c4e8a7: A wireless communication service that uses the networks of multiple telecommunications carriers and approximately 40,000 public wireless LAN spots nationwide.
entries.39589c5c3e90f59a: A wireless communication service using the networks of multiple telecommunications carriers and approximately 40,000 public wireless LAN spots nationwide. It is centered on the WiMAX service; sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥8,272 million, of which the WiMAX service accounted for ¥6,755 million. It also provides related services such as the Wi-Fi service, plans with smartphone insurance and PC insurance, the monthly version of Virus Buster Cloud, and antibacterial glass coating. It sells mainly through consumer electronics retailers, mobile phone shops and its own EC site, and it is a stock-type billing model in which usage fee revenue from paying monthly members arises continuously.

entries.72123618dc0ad7c7: The company is a wireless broadband operator headquartered in Shinagawa Ward, Tokyo. It is a mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) that provides services by purchasing lines from telecommunications carriers without owning its own communications facilities; the company and 1 consolidated subsidiary make up the group, and the number of employees as of December 31, 2025 was 55. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.

entries.ff8fe2063fe4d6b4: This is a mobile WiFi device rental service run by FREEDiVE Inc., which became a wholly owned subsidiary in November 2025. It operates brands including "MUGEN WiFi," "AIR WiFi" and "5G CONNECT" and has a track record in EC sales of mobile Wi-Fi services. It is a stock-type billing model based on usage fee income from monthly paid members. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, only the balance sheet was consolidated, so its results are not included in revenue for the current period.
